t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pink brown and red gnomes have one basket colour, blue green and orange have another colour. Pick a basket colour and choose the corrosponding gnomes until the mushroom amounts start to shrink, then switch.

vb_textbox.text: There are coloured gnomes, they link with baskets. Red, Purple, Pink and Brown gnomes bring up a red basket. Blue, Yellow, Green and Orange gnomes bring up an orange basket. Pick a coloured basket and stick with the gnome associated with that colour until the number of points significantly decreases; when this happens try switching to the other coloured basket. Good luck!
